_comment: Ontogram Memory MCP. Prefer the HTTP entry: it works with ANY MCP client (Claude Code, Antigravity, Pi, OpenCode, Cursor, ...) by pointing at one URL, no local process needed. If ONTOGRAM_TOKEN is set on the bridge, add an 'Authorization': 'Bearer <token>' header entry per your client's header support. The stdio entry is a fallback for clients that spawn a subprocess instead of connecting to a URL; it requires the local .venv on the same machine.
